CSIR Assistant Section Officer ASO Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information :New India Assurance Company Ltd (NIACL) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Section Officer ASO. This recruitment has been issued for 100 posts. The online application process for CSIR Assistant Section Officer ASO Recruitment 2026 has started on 23 June 2026, and candidates can apply till 13 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for CSIR Assistant Section Officer ASO Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 June 2026
  • Last Date : 13 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

  • Apply Online

  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is CSIR Assistant Section Officer ASO Online Form 2026?

CSIR Assistant Section Officer ASO Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 13 July 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.csir.res.in/en

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
